_source: Nightly Integration Tests run 38293267846 (2026-10-12), reports-both-<shard> artifacts, *-results.xml. Newer runs name them reports-<backend>-<shard>.
_units: Minutes of pytest time per connector marker, summed across both graph legs. Each CI job now runs one leg; Neo4j is the slower one (about 55-65% of these figures).
_core_note: The `core` shard is not marker-split: it runs everything the connector shards do not name, plus the browser tests. Measured at ~52 min of work (34 min pytest across both legs, the rest Playwright) in the same run. Shown for reference; only the connector shards can be rebalanced by moving markers.

_caveats.gitlab: Kept from the 2026-09-19 run: on 2026-10-12 its tests errored within seconds, so that run's 0.2 min says nothing.
_caveats.local_fs: Kept from the 2026-09-19 run (nearer 19 min per its note then): every local_fs test skipped on 2026-10-12.
_caveats.google_drive: google_drive_workspace and google_drive_individual measured from the connectors-2 job of manual run 38789665806 (2026-10-15): workspace 81.4 min (Neo4j, scenario matrix included) + 79.8 min (ArangoDB), individual 28.2 + 26.5 min. Workspace is the longest suite now, so it has a shard to itself.
_caveats.zendesk: Estimated, not measured: this suite is new (19 tests, no scenario matrix). Replace with the minutes from the first run that executes it.
_caveats.notion: One suite and the second longest; it gets a shard to itself, and that shard sets the length the multi-suite shards pack up to.
